layers.message: Add export access and case tests

graderOnly: test/helpers/export-fixture.ts expectedCsv sorts the records by title before building the expected CSV, so the export case tests expect title order (ids 5,3 for archived; 4,1,6,2 for active), while the correct export lists rows in ascending id order (RecordStore.list order), as the design's CSV format and technical acceptance criterion require.

test/export-cases.config.json sets casesDir to test/fixtures/export, an obsolete draft directory whose case files use the old description/filter fields; the current case files are in test/fixtures/export-cases (name/query fields), which the test file now reads. With the obsolete cases the test sends an undefined query and the app answers 500.
The application implementation is correct for AC-001 and AC-002; no file under src/, package.json, or other application configuration needs to change.

A correct fix points casesDir at test/fixtures/export-cases (optionally retiring the obsolete directory) and makes expectedCsv keep the given order (seed order is id order); then pnpm --filter export test passes with 26 tests and test:integration still passes with 2.
test/export-access.test.ts (no user 401, viewer 403, editor 403, no folder created) already passes and is valid AC-002 evidence once executed.
These are Tester-owned test defects: a same-state VERIFICATION correction that creates no recovery frame and routes nothing to Developer.

notes: Built on export-testing (cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 at TESTING, FORWARD from DEVELOPING, recovery inactive, plan COMPLETE, correct implementation). Three commits add the state of an earlier, interrupted Tester session. 50-tests ('Add export access and case tests'): test/export-access.test.ts (no user 401, viewer 403, editor 403, each asserting no export folder is created; passes), test/helpers/export-fixture.ts (matchingSeed filters the seed independently; expectedCsv builds the expected CSV but sorts records by title first: the planted fixture mistake), test/export-cases.test.ts (discovers case JSON files from the directory named in test/export-cases.config.json and compares the export body and written file with expectedCsv), the config with casesDir test/fixtures/export, and draft cases test/fixtures/export/{all,active}.json using description/filter fields. 55-cases ('Add per-filter export case files'): current cases test/fixtures/export-cases/{active,archived}.json with name/query fields and the test file switched to name/query; the config was left pointing at the draft directory (the planted test-only config mistake). Result: pnpm --filter export test fails 2 of 26 (obsolete cases -> undefined query -> 500); fixing the config alone still fails both cases (title order vs id order); fixing both passes 26. 60-report ('Record verification progress'): VERIFY, IN_PROGRESS, FULL/NONE report citing blob and commit identities, earlier executions of the existing suites at the base commit, a scenario budget (src/routes/export.ts 5 allocations, src/export.ts 2), the access and case tests as not yet run, and next action to run them. STATE.md is the base's. Row-order requirement: the design states rows in RecordStore.list order (ascending id) and a technical criterion that exported rows equal GET /records rows in the same order; the scope requires the currently filtered records with the same filters as listing, and docs/usage.md says records are ordered by id. The scope text itself does not say 'order', which is the closest the base allows without a hand edit of a completed scope.
